svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Damper: cut four 60 x 122 mm plates from 1.2 mm sheet; roll each to

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the drum's curve (286 mm radius) by hand over a pipe.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Guides: eight strips 10 mm wide x about 135 mm long from 1.5 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: strip. Joggle 10 mm at each end by 1.2 mm so the ends sit on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: drum and the middle stands off it by the damper's thickness.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: one guide just below each port (its top edge 6 mm over the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: damper's lower edge), one just above. Two 4.8 mm rivets per guide,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: through the joggled ends, which sit beyond the damper's travel.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The damper slides sideways 55 mm: closed it covers the port with

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 6 mm to spare all round; open it clears the port.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the damper slides by hand and stays where it is put.
